one_liner: Harvest (time tracking) has a documented v2 REST API with many resource areas. The pages don't confirm the auth methods, free-tier API access or the MCP server, so those are carried over from the draft at low confidence.
auth_notes: The fetched pages only show that an Authentication doc section exists. They don't describe personal access tokens or OAuth2 for Harvest. The draft's PAT and OAuth2 claims come from pages that weren't provided. Composio's catalog lists OAUTH2 as a managed scheme for Harvest, which is consistent with OAuth2 support.
access_notes: The provided pages only show a "Free 30-day trial" on the homepage. They don't say whether the API is available on a free plan. The draft's quote about API access on all accounts, including free ones, came from a page that wasn't provided. I kept self_serve_free at low confidence. If free-plan API access isn't real, the correct value is self_serve_trial.
blocker_notes: The Greenhouse "Harvest API" pages in the fetch set are a different product (Greenhouse Recruiting) and were ignored. The MCP Registry shows no servers under the vendor namespace, and no provided page confirms the Harvest MCP. The MCP value is therefore unverified. Webhooks, sandbox and OpenAPI status are unknown.
